claim_decisions.statement: The2026 UNDP-ITC report describes conflict and displacement restricting pastoral routes and water points, pushing livestock onto cropland and aggravating farmer-pastoralist tensions in Darfur/Kordofan.
claim_decisions.locator: Printed p.71 (one-based PDF p.90), livestock constraints.
claim_decisions.uncertainty: Source synthesis/consultations, not quantified incident rates or proof climate caused initial violence.

pathways.climate_pressure: Drought, floods and erratic rainfall described as additional yield pressures in the2026 agri-food report.
pathways.documented_impact: Agricultural losses coexist with unsafe harvest access and disrupted pastoral livelihoods in conflict-affected areas.
pathways.fcv_mediator: Insecurity, displacement, restricted routes/water points and weakened customary institutions narrow access to land, water and inputs.
pathways.possible_consequence: These constraints can reduce the ability of farmers and pastoralists to absorb weather-related livelihood shocks and can aggravate existing resource tensions.
alternative_explanations: Input prices, finance, markets, land governance and conflict itself can reduce production and intensify tensions independently of weather.
pathways.uncertainty: Conditional reverse interaction from a consultation-based2026report; separate effects and named climate-adaptation delivery impacts are not measured.
resilience_factors: Customary management capacities are described as eroded, not absent everywhere; proposed water/community measures are not evaluated results.
pathways.compact_statement: In Darfur/Kordofan, insecurity and restricted land/water access narrow weather-shock coping options and can aggravate resource tensions.

gaps: The May2022 synthesis predates the current war and is not used to explain its onset.
The expired June-September2026 worst-case famine-risk scenario was excluded from operational evidence.
The livestock-route passage is printed p.71/one-basedPDFp.90, not the intake's printed p.72.

executive_assessment.text: Sennar/Gedaref seasonal crop stress is differentiated from Darfur/Kordofan insecurity and resource-access constraints; neither is treated as proof that climate caused the war.
Water infrastructure and community governance are proposed capacities, with inconsistent project-page coverage and no independent peace-effect evaluation.
